reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, which is more than most brands show me, but it is a brand with zero reviews and I do not buy without hundreds. I would have nobody's 1-star reviews to read about stomach upset or whether the dose is real.
objection: No reviews at all. A QR report is the brand's own claim until I see hundreds of real buyers say the capsules are easy on the stomach, and $29.99 for 30 servings is also more per serving than what I already have on Subscribe & Save.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred verified reviews with a decent share of 4 and 5 stars and no pattern of stomach or dosing complaints in the 1-star ones, plus a lower price per serving or a first-order discount.
